intro: Soft, simple, and effortlessly elegant, this square cotton cushion cover blends timeless black stripes on a crisp white base. It brings a sense of cozy sophistication and easy comfort to any space.

features.title: Timeless touch, crafted right
features.text: Made from breathable and durable cotton, this cushion cover offers exceptional comfort while maintaining its shape and quality over time.

features.title: Blends right in, but steals the show
features.text: Its neutral tones and clean lines make it a versatile addition, blending seamlessly with bold or understated interior styles.

features.title: Not just made but masterfully crafted
features.text: Meticulously stitched for a flawless finish, this cushion cover exemplifies superior attention to detail and design.

care: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash with mild detergent and cold water. Wash separately to prevent color bleeding. Do not tumble dry. Do not bleach. Dry inside out in shade. Do not iron.
name: 18x18 Cotton Square Cushion Cover
